subject: Quarter stitchpoint: status snapshot, scope nudges, and dependency asks
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Leadership Group <leadership@redwood.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 24 Jul 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quarter stitchpoint: status snapshot, scope nudges, and dependency asks

Team —

Quick mid-quarter snapshot and asks so the QBR pack doesn't surprise anyone. I put a one-page pulse (attached) + a short dependency grid. High-level:

- Serving runtime throughput: green for core customers, but we're seeing a 12% tail latency increase on long-context GPT-Lite variants during sustained bursts.
- Redwood Dedicated onboarding: two customers (Acme + PartnerCo) are blocked on SSO + custom VPC routes.
- Optimize recommendations: an opportunity to trim cost by 8–12% via caching + quantization profile changes, but requires infra work and an eval window.

Immediate asks (owners + ETA):
1) Infra: allocate a small burst GPU pool and tweak kernel selection for long-context paths (owner: Marcus Lin) — need decision by Mon 7/27.
2) Security/SPO: confirm VPC route templates and DocuSign on Acme contract redlines (owner: Naomi Feldman) — ETA Wed 7/29.
3) Product/Research: run a 48-hour quantization/eval trial on two high-volume models (owner: Aditya Rao) — start by 7/28.
4) Sales/CS: keep Acme and PartnerCo in the loop on timelines; avoid verbal commitments until we have the infra decision. (owner: Karthik)

If we can lock the infra decision next week we can present a clean mitigation plan in the QBR. I intentionally kept the one-pager tight for exec review — slides are on the Drive link below.

Attachments: QBR_stitchpoint_onepager_v1.pdf; pipeline-dep-owners.xlsx

Thanks —
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Platform Product
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Leadership Group <leadership@redwood.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 24 Jul 2026 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter stitchpoint: status snapshot, scope nudges, and dependency asks

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear snapshot and the asks. Two quick notes:

- On Acme SSO/VPC: I can escalate to infra networking today, but I need the specific iptables/VPC route template from Marcus' team to avoid back-and-forth. Marcus, can you drop that in the shared spreadsheet?
- On DocuSign redlines: legal flagged the data residency paragraph — if Acme wants EU-only logs we need to surface Private deployment timelines to their procurement team. I suggest Naomi loop with Sales to set expectation that Private is a separate path.

I can commit to getting legal's checklist by EOD Tue (7/28) if I get the route template by EOD Mon.

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 24 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter stitchpoint: status snapshot, scope nudges, and dependency asks

On it — I'll paste the VPC route templates and a short kernel-selection note into the spreadsheet in the next 2 hours.

A couple of operational realities:
- We can spin a small burst pool (4x A10s equivalent) within 48 hours, but it requires a short-term quota bump and a canary policy; cost hit ~est $10k/week.
- Kernel changes for long-context paths will need a 24-hour bench + 12-hour smoke on perf infra. If we approve now I can have a trial window starting 7/28 as requested.

I'll flag the quota request to infra ops and tag SRE for the canary.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
VP, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Leadership Group <leadership@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, naomi_feldman@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 24 Jul 2026 12:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter stitchpoint: status snapshot, scope nudges, and dependency asks

Thanks — this is helpful and exactly the sort of concise steer I want ahead of the QBR. Two quick items from the exec side:

1) Prioritize customer-facing fixes that remove blockers for committed deals (Acme). The cost of a short-term quota bump is acceptable if it preserves the committed ARR.
2) For the QBR slide, can you convert the attached one-pager into an executive 6-bullet brief (no more than 120 words) that calls out: impact, mitigation, owner, ETA, risk, ask? Put it in the Drive link.

I'll clear the business escalation for the quota bump once Marcus confirms SRE can run the canary and we have a conservative rollback plan.

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Chief Operating Officer
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, Acme Analytics <sarah.lyons@acme-analytics.com>, Partner Enablement <marketplace@partnerco.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Jul 2026 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter stitchpoint: status snapshot, scope nudges, and dependency asks

Appreciate the quick turns — updated plan below and I've uploaded the 6-bullet executive brief to the Drive link (filename: QBR_exec_bullets_v1.txt).

Updated commitments:
- Marcus: submit VPC route templates + file a short SRE-runbook by 12:00pm PT Mon (7/27). Canary plan included.
- Naomi: legal checklist for DocuSign redlines by EOD Tue (7/28).
- Aditya: start 48-hour quantization/eval trial on two variants on 7/28; deliver results summary by 7/30.
- Me: coordinate Acme and PartnerCo communications — I'll send a short note to Sarah at Acme clarifying timelines (no promises) and ask PartnerCo to confirm production cutover windows.

Next steps for the QBR pack: I'll replace the one-pager with the exec bullets and a short appendix with the dep ownership spreadsheet. If anything changes, I'll update the Drive link and flag the change in this thread.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Platform Product
Redwood Inference
